tools.name: echo
tools.title: Echo
tools.description: Echo the input text back. Use to verify connectivity to the Sovereign OS MCP server.

tools.name: list_canon_pages
tools.title: List canon pages
tools.description: List active Sovereign OS canon pages (Watershed Thesis, Fire Defense, Below the Radar, Regenerative Gem, etc.) with slugs, audiences, and navigation notes.

status.description: Filter by status. Defaults to active.

tools.name: list_my_facts
tools.title: List my Gemma facts
tools.description: List durable facts Gemma remembers about the signed-in operator (from gemma_facts). Optionally filter by room scope.

scope_room.description: Optional room slug (e.g. 'outreach', 'radar') to scope facts to.

include_retired.description: Include retired facts. Defaults to false.

tools.name: remember_fact
tools.title: Remember a fact
tools.description: Save a durable fact into Gemma's memory layer (gemma_facts) for the signed-in operator. Optionally scope it to a room.

fact.description: The fact to remember (atomic, one idea).

scope_room.description: Optional room slug to scope the fact (e.g. 'outreach'). Omit for global.

pinned.description: Pin the fact so it always injects. Defaults to false.
